**Subject:**
- Primary: Juvenile human (approx. 8–12 years), short brown hair, wearing red zip-up jacket with Italian flag patch on left sleeve and Kappa logo on right chest; dark blue jeans; black sneakers. Right hand gripping shaft of hockey stick; left hand resting flat on ground for balance. Body in crouched position, knees bent, torso leaning forward slightly.

**Setting:**
- Outdoor or semi-outdoor sports facility. Background consists of white synthetic mesh netting stretched over red-painted metal frame (goal structure). Ground surface is composite material — light gray concrete slab adjacent to darker reddish-brown rubberized matting. No visible spectators, equipment beyond stick/net, or signage.

**Lighting:**
- Diffuse natural daylight. Even illumination across subject and background. Minimal shadowing under body or objects suggests overcast sky or shaded environment. No artificial highlights or directional glare.

**Composition:**
- Medium shot, eye-level perspective. Subject centered horizontally, occupying lower two-thirds vertically. Hockey stick extends diagonally from bottom-right toward center-left, creating leading line. Netting fills upper half, providing textural contrast and depth. Framing includes partial view of goalpost edges on left and right margins. Depth of field shallow enough to keep subject sharp while softly blurring distant netting layers.
